title: Sagas: Ruins
short_description: Ruined temples, a cathedral, arches and stone circles from the CC0 3TD Fantasy Ruins Pack, the gates of Menlo Castle (Co. Galway, photogrammetry) and a mammoth skeleton from the Smithsonian.
long_description:
Ruined temples, a cathedral, arches and stone circles from the CC0 3TD Fantasy Ruins Pack, the gates of Menlo Castle (Co. Galway, photogrammetry) and a mammoth skeleton from the Smithsonian.

Requires the **sagas** mod, which places these landmarks during map generation
where their site fits and builds them from the materials of the game and the site.

| Landmark | Size | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Ruined cathedral | 29 x 20 x 45 | plain or slope |
| Old foundation | 15 x 8 x 11 | plain or slope |
| Mammoth skeleton | 20 x 36 x 53 | plain or slope |
| Gates of Menlo Castle | 47 x 20 x 12 | plain or plain+river or slope |
| Broken aqueduct arch | 27 x 18 x 13 | plain or slope or river |
| Speaking stones | 21 x 9 x 19 | plain or ridge |
| Overgrown temple | 27 x 15 x 26 | plain or ridge or peak |
| Temple of the four arches | 30 x 24 x 31 | plain or ridge or peak |
| Ruined wall | 21 x 9 x 2 | cave_mouth+against_rock or slope+against_rock or cliff+against_rock or plain+against_rock |

Every schematic is an adaptation of a freely licensed model; see ATTRIBUTION.md for sources.
